symptom: Readers with different configured TTLs disagree about expiry.
resolution: Persist deadlines in entries/settle/demote ops, instead of deriving with reader configuration.

symptom: A late note on an already approved task has no correct lifetime.
resolution: Settle old approvals and give late short notes their own clock; approved promotable notes can start long.

symptom: An explicit short-horizon note is promoted on approval or loses its own deadline.
resolution: Keep explicit short intent and deadline through settlement.

symptom: A crash between board approval, settle append and promotion loses settlement effects.
resolution: Reconcile approvals at startup and finish logged settlement on later reads.

symptom: Demoting a promoted copy exposes a hidden long-lived original; repeated promotion chains drift.
resolution: Derive the original/copy chain together for demote/forget operations.

symptom: A superseded settled source expires or fails to return/promote when its replacement disappears.
resolution: Retain promotable source, derive replacement liveness and promote held sources on forget/expiry.

symptom: Promotion changes chronology or drops a replacement relation.
resolution: Promotion keeps source date/provenance and supersession.

symptom: Local or separately written supersessions form a cycle.
resolution: Refuse local cycle creation; derive a deterministic broken cycle for split writers.

symptom: An older embedded supersedes relation clobbers a later explicit operation.
resolution: Fold both sources chronologically with deterministic time/id precedence.

symptom: Notes on tasks never approved remain forever in the active index.
resolution: Persist fixed 180-day backstop; keep append-only history.

symptom: Model-written answers or unconfirmed inferred relations become circular evidence.
resolution: Exclude ahub ask answers from import/evidence; keep suggestions non-evidence until a person confirms them.

symptom: One claude-mem observation hashes differently on different checkouts or deny settings.
resolution: Text-only import associations stabilize content identity across machines.

symptom: Legacy duplicate import groups survive sync; naive dedupe can overwrite person replacements.
resolution: Read-only dedupe plan plus explicit append-only apply, preserve existing replacements and group forget.

symptom: Two machines promoting one demoted entry can create two copies.
resolution: Deterministic promotion identity independent of promoting process.

symptom: A previously given short-term id no longer resolves after promotion or on a remote with only the synced copy.
resolution: Resolve original ids through promotedFrom, locally and remotely.

symptom: Native own-platform recall repeats context already injected by hooks.
resolution: Claude/Codex get other-platform blocks; other peers get combined recall.

symptom: The first platform consumes a cross-platform recall budget.
resolution: Split the budget across returned platform blocks and remove repeated legends.

symptom: A stopped/changed/hung worker could block or fail a turn.
resolution: 2-second fail-open client returns undefined and logs the dropped call.

symptom: Local-worker summarize was skipped as subagent context.
resolution: Omit agentId on summarize; live 13.25.1 observation recorded.

symptom: Unawaited session-end disappears when the process exits.
resolution: Await bounded Capture.end at shutdown.

symptom: A new fail note reaches only the next session, after a peer retries the rejected approach.
resolution: Ride notes on the other peers next delivery, newest ten, without a separate turn.

symptom: A failed delivery returns an old preface over a newer preface.
resolution: Merge/restore the preface without overwriting newer memory.

symptom: Generated guidance treats workflow task/review events as reference-only memory.
resolution: Distinguish message kinds; only presence recall is reference.

symptom: Observer returns prose twice instead of observation XML and drops queued batches.
resolution: Later observation reports lastSuccess and zero consecutiveFailures; exact dropped data recovery was not established.

symptom: Observer allowance/provider failure stops capture.
resolution: Historical OpenRouter switch restored processing; ongoing cost and maintenance conflict remained.

symptom: Plugin registration exists but cache runtime, correct home or recall adapter is absent.
resolution: Historical cache dependency installation and later dot memory adapter repair; not a current live-readiness claim.
source: CM S6037; CM #197226; MEMORY.md:177; rollout 01a13bd8, lines 35-37

symptom: SessionStart context hooks run before the claude-mem launcher compilation completes.
resolution: Self-heal completes; identical hook rerun exits zero. Missing-PATH/version-cache hypotheses were disproved.

symptom: Global LIMIT before project filtering starves target imports; repeated runs replay the same window or skip a recreated lower-id source.
resolution: Project-aware SQL and persisted cursor advance handled rows; restart reconsiders skips; reset compares selected-project candidate ids.
source: issue #380; PR #389; test/memory-phase3.test.ts:120; test/memory-phase3.test.ts:147; test/memory-phase3.test.ts:171; commit d5738472

symptom: Unrelated repositories with the same basename share claude-mem recall/import scope.
resolution: Native memory origin key fixes its own namespace; claude-mem basename ambiguity remains. Import comment gives no local cure.

symptom: Importing the whole superproject chain imports another projects notes under this projects policy.
resolution: Import selects only chain.at(-1), the current source project.

symptom: Native basename/path or unscoped-id lookups collide across projects/machines.
resolution: Canonical origin key, local path hash fallback, project-scoped id access and native worktree aliases.

symptom: A replacement narrows visibility and suppresses an entry for readers that cannot see the replacement.
resolution: Reject narrower replacement visibility.

symptom: A done/review/unmet/context summary on an ordinary task carries PII to cloud memory.
resolution: Pattern/screen withheld text remains on board; memory and public peer messages receive no private body.
source: issue #69; PR #73; issue #185 / PR #192; CHANGELOG.md:363; CHANGELOG.md:232

symptom: Raw hub tool arguments/results bypass Tasks privacy refusal via local capture.
resolution: Exclude task/conductor/hub_send capture, keeping ordinary tool capture.

symptom: An ordinary local turn reads full PII board rows and then captures/repeats them.
resolution: Return stubs except during an in-process PII turn; PII turns never capture.

symptom: Private path references in text, refs, symbols or Unicode/space paths reach either memory.
resolution: Check private paths before native/cloud writes and in model-facing records.

symptom: A previously accepted/shared/synced note violates the current receiving policy or has sensitive metadata.
resolution: Rescreen whole records on model-facing reads, including nodes/project/secret patterns.

symptom: Invalid unrelated config field silently empties pii.paths for memory CLI reads.
resolution: Strict policy load fails closed; malformed present config is distinct from absence.

symptom: Promotion sends local short notes to synced long-term storage without a current policy verdict.
resolution: PromotionScreen must promote/keep/skip under source-project policy; rescreen task current paths and hold unknown project.

symptom: Sync publishes note text to a public remote, or visibility cannot be verified.
resolution: Known-public refused; unknown visibility only warns (residual policy limit); forget does not purge Git history.

symptom: Tracked project configuration redirects the cloud memory endpoint to receive task text.
resolution: Memory endpoint applies only from machine-local untracked configuration, checked by file identity.

symptom: Malformed, bad-id, non-string or invalid-time synced lines poison derived state.
resolution: Validate schema/content hash/types/time; skip invalid rows and wait for partial tails.

symptom: Truncation or same-size/deep prefix rewrite evades byte-offset indexing.
resolution: Hash indexed prefixes and rebuild on shrink/change.

symptom: A durable log append is reported failed when derived SQLite refresh is busy, encouraging duplicate retries.
resolution: Return saved id after durable append; mark index stale and log refresh failure.

symptom: Catching the failed refresh without retry makes saved notes permanently invisible to this process.
resolution: Read paths ensure freshness and retry a dirty index.

symptom: A long-lived reader misses another processes durable write whose indexing failed.
resolution: Compare segment shape on reads as well as local stale state.

symptom: Goal/link/lease and suggestion/verdict reads bypass note freshness recovery.
resolution: Share ensureFresh across those read families; no new log/index format.

symptom: Idle expiry is hidden by view filtering while index rows still differ from rebuild.
resolution: Prune on read so derived rows and rebuild agree.

symptom: Concurrent first-open or corrupt winning machine.json files yield inconsistent/undefined machine identity.
resolution: Exclusive creation then common validated reread; malformed id fails store construction.

symptom: Killed Git leaves index.lock or interrupted merge, hiding subsequent local entries from sync.
resolution: Signed machine sync lock serializes Git; clear stale owned Git lock and abort interrupted merge.

symptom: Concurrent pushes or absent/unreachable remote make memory transport fail.
resolution: Own-machine segments, pull/merge, one retry after push race; errors return fail-open result.

symptom: Two machines claim one goal before synchronization.
resolution: Advisory earlier-claim winner with conflict displayed; force resolution by person; broker needed for consensus.

symptom: Promote check and append race with another processes forget/replacement.
resolution: Open ceiling: per-machine mutation lock would make check+append atomic.

symptom: Every refresh hashes the whole indexed prefix, O(segment bytes).
resolution: Open ceiling: block hash chain if measured scale warrants it.

symptom: Repeated concurrent writers exceed bounded refresh retries.
resolution: Open ceiling: five retry levels then deferred work; shared read lock is proposed upgrade.

symptom: Views materialize/filter all rows in process memory.
resolution: Open ceiling: SQL filtering when store size warrants it.

symptom: Clock rollback resurrects an expired row after rebuild.
resolution: Open ceiling: durable prune entry, instead of wall-clock-only expiry.

symptom: Three-characters-per-token approximation is not an exact token ceiling.
resolution: Open ceiling: tokenizer if exact bounds are required.

symptom: Dashboard Memory recomputes the whole index per poll.
resolution: Open ceiling: cache by index revision when measured poll cost warrants it.

symptom: Adoption decisions lack causal effectiveness/cost measurements; brief counts cannot prove a failed approach was retried.
resolution: #247/#248/#258 ship counts/arms/report plumbing; controlled arms, field window and manual retry labels remain owed.
source: issue #248 AC2-4; issue #258 AC11; PR #351; PR #356; docs/smoke.md:68; docs/research.md:88
